text:
Alex CSM: Heads-up for QBR pack: HARBORLIGHT shows an odd jump in token spend concentrated in analytics/embeds pipeline. Need a short slide: root cause, tiered forecast (baseline/likely/worst), and immediate mitigations by EOD.

Jordan (FinOps): on it. pls send last 45d & current commit. I'll produce three scenarios and a recommended cushion for renewal talk.

Ibrahim Eng: initial look: surge correlates with the nightly analytics job that now computes 3 extra contexts per item after an internal change. Also seeing duplicate vectors for near-identical inputs (no dedupe).

Marta (Enablement): I'll prep a 1-pager targeted at their infra/dev teams: batching + vector dedupe + optional dimensionality reduction; include quick code snippets.

costbot: Alert: HARBORLIGHT crossed 73% of monthly allocation. AlertID: cb-12055

Alex CSM: Action list: 1) Ibrahim  confirm pipeline change and ETA to patch dedupe (30m). 2) Jordan  three-scenario numbers + cushion rec by 14:30. 3) Marta  one-pager + example snippet by EOD. I will draft an outreach offering a 30-min remediation session and temporary soft-limits.

Ibrahim Eng: confirmed: PR merged last Tue that added "context_expansion=3" in analytics worker. Rolling hotfix to make expansion conditional and add a dedupe step. ETA 25m.

Jordan (FinOps): quick baseline numbers: 30d_tokens=760000, 7d_tokens=290000, monthly_commit=800000.
Projections:
- baseline (no change) = ~880k
- likely (post-hotfix) = ~820k
- worst-case (if expansion persists) = ~1.9M
Recommend 18% credit cushion at renewal and a temporary soft throttle at 65% until dedupe is live.

Marta (Enablement): checklist draft: 1) enable batching header; 2) normalize and dedupe inputs before embed; 3) reduce dim size for background analytics; 4) apply sampling for low-value items. Snippet for Python:
```
# client-side dedupe example
from collections import OrderedDict
inputs = list(OrderedDict.fromkeys(inputs))
resp = client.embeds.create(model="rwd-embed-1", input=inputs, batch_size=64)
```

Alex CSM: Great. I'll include a "before/after" cost slide showing Jordan's worst/best projections and propose the soft throttle + offer to help implement dedupe. Drafting customer note now and will post in #customer-comm. :thumbsup:

Ibrahim Eng: hotfix deployed; dedupe step added and context_expansion made opt-in. Monitoring shows token burn trending down. Will follow up with telemetry snapshot in 2 hrs.

costbot: Alert resolved: usage trending down after fix.

Alex CSM: Thanks all. Jordan  please attach sensitivity table (5/15/30% uplifts) to the QBR appendix. Marta  add the one-pager to the QBR handout. Reconvene if alerts reappear.
